annotations.title: Resolve free text to image parameters

description: Free. The first call for any picture of a car, including one you chose yourself: turn a request such as "red 2018 Mazda MX-5 Miata side view" into the catalog vehicle and exact get_car_image parameters (vehicle_id, make, model, year, view, color), plus alternative candidates and a confidence of high, medium or low. A make and model are read by the rules the image tools read them with, so this names the vehicle they would render. Pass params.vehicle_id as vehicle to get_car_image, create_car_image_urls or create_3d_model. Ask the human to choose when confidence is low or several candidates fit, and tell them when params.year is not the year they asked for (extracted.year).

market.description: Market of sale, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code such as US, GB, DE, AU or JP. Send it only when the human named a market or the vehicles are for one: some model years look different in different markets. Today every market gets the default appearance, and the answer's appearance says which was served. Omit it otherwise: the account's default market applies, if it set one. Never guess it from where the human is.

query.description: What the human asked for, in words: year, make and model, plus the view and color when they named them, e.g. "red 2024 porsche 911 side view".
